responsibility: This implementation module supplies the runtime support behind the SYSTEM module’s multi-word BITSET operations. Using libc memcpy/memset and builtin SHIFT on individual BITSET words, it implements ShiftVal, ShiftLeft, ShiftRight, RotateVal, RotateLeft, and RotateRight for set sizes larger than a machine word, normalizing counts modulo the set width and copying unchanged data when no transformation is needed. It is the low-level bit-manipulation backend called by generated gm2 code when SYSTEM SHIFT/ROTATE cannot be expanded inline.
same_name_distinction: Runtime backend half of the SYSTEM pair: unlike SYSTEM.def's broad compiler-facing declarations, this file actually implements only the multi-word BITSET Shift*/Rotate* support routines, using memcpy/memset and per-word SHIFT operations for generated code that cannot inline them.
